powerbanks.display: LCD showing battery percentage, real-time watts, volts, and amps

measured.single_port: 20V/3A in AND out with the bundled cable (Amazon.co.jp review 2025-09-21, USB tester)
measured.input_taper: ~100W early from a 100W PD charger, dropping to 50-60W as charging progressed (Amazon.co.jp review 2025-09-14, USB tester, reviewer acknowledges measurement error)
measured.capacity_discrepancy: 74Wh input for a 0-100% recharge implies ~20000mAh at 3.7V, not 27000mAh; that reviewer returned the unit. Single tester, unverified.
measured.multi_output: All ports drop to 5V during 3-device simultaneous use and pass-through (two independent Amazon.co.jp reviews).

charge_curves.reference: Amazon.co.jp USB-tester review: near 100W early, 50-60W later; no time/SOC detail published
charge_curves.note: Two-step approximation - the reviewer published no timing. Medium confidence.

charge_behavior.notes: Vendor spec: 65W input (20V/3.25A), ~2.5h full charge, 27000mAh/99.3Wh. Independent USB-tester reviews contradict parts of that: measured input peaked near 100W from a 100W PD charger before tapering to 50-60W, a full recharge consumed 74Wh of input energy (~20000mAh real), and all ports drop to 5V in 3-device use. Treat 65W as the conservative model value and the measured numbers as caveats. No lab PDO dump or PPS range exists for this model - PPS is undocumented/unverified; only fixed 20V/3A has been observed. Dual-input (both USB-C ports charging the bank) is undocumented - treat as unsupported. Pass-through supported but self-recharge slows; no numeric split published. EPR 28V/5A output (140W) remains unverified by any measurement. Efficiency revised from 0.61 (a figure back-derived from the vendor 2.5h claim) to 0.85, matching measured bank input->stored efficiencies; with the reviewer's two-step taper this lands near the vendor's 2.5h full-charge claim.
charge_behavior.confidence_note: measured fields are single-reviewer USB-tester readings, not lab tests

output.notes: Output-only. Wattage not confirmed in listings; 22.5W is a typical ceiling for this class. Verify with a meter.

powerbanks.cable_gotcha: To reach the full 140W output (28V/5A PD 3.1 EPR) you need a 240W/EPR-rated cable. The included 100W cable is limited to 20V/5A = 100W. The listing FAQ claims the included cable supports maximum output, which contradicts the PD 3.1 spec.

powerbanks.display: TFT color screen showing battery percentage, power, voltage, current, and remaining charge/discharge time

measured.sustained_output: 100W constant with no thermal or SOC throttling; 120W Xiaomi mode sustained 7 min in a load test
measured.simultaneous_c_plus_a: Disputed: manual's multi-port table caps the combination well below the marketing 100W+33W

charge_curves.reference: Tim McMahon POWER-Z (Apple 140W): 86W 0-10min, step to ~30W at 10min, declining after 30min, full 46:01, 37.3Wh in. Gizmochina: 86.2W start, 50W after 10min, 43% @10min, full 45min
charge_curves.note: Measured metered taper; the 30-46min segment is approximate.

charge_behavior.notes: Official spec IN1: 5V3A/9V3A/12V3A/15V3A/20V4.5A (90W). Reviewers measured 86W peak (20V/4.3A) and a full recharge in 44-46 min (35 min on a 100W laptop charger). The official '55% in 15 minutes' milestone is NOT reproducible from that metered curve - 86W stepping to ~38W at 10 min yields ~45% at 15 min - so the model follows the metered data. Efficiency is calibrated to 0.95 so the SOC curve's full-charge time (~52 min) tracks the metered cycle. The manual says ~1 hour with 90W+. Usable output: 30.2-31.9Wh from USB-C (83.9-88.6% efficiency), 27.4Wh from USB-A (76.0%). The bank exports PPS 5-11V/5A and 5-20V/3A (some meters read 6A on the low range; safest values kept). Covers Samsung SFC 25W. Output holds a constant 100W with no throttling. Battery: 4x 2500mAh 18650 in series (14.4V nominal). The '150W' name is Xiaomi-private 120W + USB-A 33W; standard PD max is 100W.

soc_curves.reference: Gizmochina/Tim McMahon: 43% @10min (86W until then), 55% @15min, input regulated to ~half after, full 45-46min
soc_curves.note: SOC-to-watts mapping from published milestones, calibrated so integrated input energy matches the metered 37.3Wh full charge.

ports.label: USB-C
ports.pps_note: Metered PPS: 5-11V/5A and 5-20V/3A (some meters read 6A on the low range; safest values kept). Covers Samsung SFC 25W (needs 3.3-11V >=2.75A) - the 5V floor does not affect the 9-10V operating point.

output.proprietary_note: Xiaomi proprietary fast charge can reach 120W on compatible Xiaomi devices.

powerbanks.cable_gotcha: Use the included 240W/6A USB-C cable for the full 100W standard-PD output. Xiaomi proprietary 120W charging requires a compatible Xiaomi device and is not standard USB-C PD.
